/// Defines how texture coordinates outside the [0, 1] range are handled. See
/// `ImageSampler` for usage.
/// ```as
/// let sampler = ImageSampler(
///     ImageWrap.clamp, // wrap x
///     ImageWrap.repeat, // wrap y
///     ImageFilter.bilinear
/// );
/// ```
export const enum ImageWrap {
    /// Stretches the edge pixels outward.
    clamp = 0,

    /// Tiles the image.
    repeat = 1,

    /// Tiles the image, flipping every other copy.
    mirror = 2,
}

/// Defines how image sampling is performed when scaling or transforming the
/// image. See `ImageSampler` for usage.
/// ```as
/// let sampler = ImageSampler(ImageWrap.clamp, ImageWrap.clamp, ImageFilter.nearest);
/// ```
export const enum ImageFilter {
    /// Blends the nearest pixels for smooth results.
    bilinear = 0,

    /// Picks the nearest pixel, keeping hard pixel edges.
    nearest = 1,
}

/// Sampling parameters applied when drawing an image: wrapping on each axis
/// and filtering. `ImageSampler` is a value type, built with
/// `ImageSampler(wrapX, wrapY, filter)`. See also `ImageWrap` and
/// `ImageFilter`.
/// ```as
/// export class DrawImage extends Node {
///     myImage: Image? = null;
///     sampler: ImageSampler = ImageSampler(ImageWrap.clamp, ImageWrap.clamp, ImageFilter.bilinear);
///
///     override init(context: Context): bool {
///         this.myImage = context.image("myImage");
///         return true;
///     }
///
///     override draw(renderer: Renderer): void {
///         let image = this.myImage;
///         if (image != null) {
///             renderer.drawImage(image, this.sampler, BlendMode.srcOver, 1);
///         }
///     }
/// }
/// ```
export struct ImageSampler {
    /// How the image wraps horizontally.
    wrapX: ImageWrap = ImageWrap.clamp;

    /// How the image wraps vertically.
    wrapY: ImageWrap = ImageWrap.clamp;

    /// How the image is filtered.
    filter: ImageFilter = ImageFilter.bilinear;

    /// Creates a sampler that clamps on both axes with bilinear filtering.
    constructor();

    /// Creates a sampler using the specified wrapping for the x and y axes
    /// and the specified filtering.
    /// ```as
    /// let sampler = ImageSampler(ImageWrap.repeat, ImageWrap.repeat, ImageFilter.nearest);
    /// ```
    constructor(wrapX: ImageWrap, wrapY: ImageWrap, filter: ImageFilter);
}

/// An image that can be drawn by the `Renderer`. Get one from the file's
/// assets with `context.image(name)`, or from a canvas.
/// ```as
/// export class DrawImage extends Node {
///     myImage: Image? = null;
///     sampler: ImageSampler = ImageSampler(ImageWrap.clamp, ImageWrap.clamp, ImageFilter.bilinear);
///
///     override init(context: Context): bool {
///         this.myImage = context.image("myImage");
///         return true;
///     }
///
///     override draw(renderer: Renderer): void {
///         let image = this.myImage;
///         if (image != null) {
///             renderer.drawImage(image, this.sampler, BlendMode.srcOver, 1);
///         }
///     }
/// }
/// ```
export class Image {
    /// Width of the image in pixels.
    /// ```as
    /// let image = context.image("myImage");
    /// if (image != null) {
    ///     context.log("myImage width: " + image.width.toString());
    /// }
    /// ```
    width: u32;

    /// Height of the image in pixels.
    /// ```as
    /// let image = context.image("myImage");
    /// if (image != null) {
    ///     context.log("myImage height: " + image.height.toString());
    /// }
    /// ```
    height: u32;

    /// Returns a `GPUTextureView` for sampling this image in WGSL shaders, or
    /// `null` when no view can be made. The view wraps the underlying GPU
    /// texture directly, with no copy or decode, and needs a GPU context,
    /// only available when the file uses GPU canvases. A view is immutable,
    /// so build it once and reuse it; a canvas image's view follows every
    /// frame drawn into the canvas. A view of an image asset currently
    /// samples as all zeros, with no error; draw the asset into a canvas and
    /// sample that canvas's image instead.
    unsafe view(): GPUTextureView?;

    /// Releases the image. Afterward it reads as 0 by 0 and draws nothing.
    release(): void;
}

/// Stores a list of 2D vertex positions for use with image meshes, drawn by
/// `Renderer.drawImageMesh` and `Renderer.drawImageMeshInstanced`. The same
/// type holds the texture coordinates.
/// ```as
/// let vertices = new VertexBuffer();
/// vertices.add3(Vector.xy(0, 0), Vector.xy(100, 0), Vector.xy(100, 100));
/// let uvs = new VertexBuffer();
/// uvs.add3(Vector.xy(0, 0), Vector.xy(1, 0), Vector.xy(1, 1));
/// let triangles = new TriangleBuffer();
/// triangles.add(0, 1, 2);
/// ```
export class VertexBuffer {
    /// Adds a vertex to the buffer.
    /// ```as
    /// let vb = new VertexBuffer();
    /// vb.add(Vector.xy(0, 0));
    /// ```
    unsafe add(v: Vector): void;

    /// Adds two vertices to the buffer.
    add2(a: Vector, b: Vector): void;

    /// Adds three vertices to the buffer.
    /// ```as
    /// let vb = new VertexBuffer();
    /// vb.add3(Vector.xy(0, 0), Vector.xy(1, 0), Vector.xy(1, 1));
    /// ```
    add3(a: Vector, b: Vector, c: Vector): void;

    /// Clears all vertices from the buffer.
    /// ```as
    /// let vb = new VertexBuffer();
    /// vb.reset();
    /// ```
    reset(): void;

    /// Number of vertices in the buffer.
    get length(): i32;
}

/// Stores triangle index data for use with image meshes. Each triangle is
/// three zero based indices into the mesh's `VertexBuffer`.
export class TriangleBuffer {
    /// Adds a triangle defined by the three vertex indices `a`, `b` and `c`,
    /// which are zero based.
    /// ```as
    /// let tb = new TriangleBuffer();
    /// tb.add(0, 1, 2);
    /// ```
    add(a: u32, b: u32, c: u32): void;

    /// Clears all triangles from the buffer.
    /// ```as
    /// let tb = new TriangleBuffer();
    /// tb.reset();
    /// ```
    reset(): void;

    /// Number of triangles in the buffer.
    get length(): i32;
}

/// Holds the per instance data for `Renderer.drawImageMeshInstanced`. Unlike
/// the mesh buffers it is meant to be rewritten every frame.
/// ```as
/// let instances = new MeshInstances(2);
/// instances.set(0, Mat2D.withTranslation(10, 20));
/// instances.set(1, Mat2D.identity(), 0.5, 0, Vector.xy(0, 0), Vector.xy(0.5, 0.5));
/// ```
export class MeshInstances {
    /// Creates a `MeshInstances` holding `count` instances, none by default.
    /// Every instance starts at the identity transform and full opacity.
    constructor(count: i32 = 0);

    /// Number of instances.
    get length(): i32;

    /// Sets the number of instances. New instances start at the identity
    /// transform and full opacity.
    /// ```as
    /// let mi = new MeshInstances();
    /// mi.resize(3);
    /// ```
    resize(count: i32): void;

    /// Writes the instance at `index`, which is zero based. Everything past
    /// `transform` is optional: `opacity` defaults to 1, `additiveness` to 0,
    /// and the UV transform to no translation and a scale of 1.
    /// ```as
    /// let mi = new MeshInstances(2);
    /// mi.set(0, Mat2D.withTranslationVector(Vector.xy(10, 20)));
    /// mi.set(1, Mat2D.identity(), 0.5, 0, Vector.xy(0, 0), Vector.xy(0.5, 0.5));
    /// ```
    set(
        index: i32,
        transform: Mat2D,
        opacity: f32 = 1,
        additiveness: f32 = 0,
        uvTranslate: Vector = Vector(0, 0),
        uvScale: Vector = Vector(1, 1)
    ): void;
}
